headline: Sources: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane suffered torn ACL vs. Chiefs
summary: Dolphins running back De'Von Achane suffered a torn ACL during Sunday's loss to the Chiefs and will be out for the rest of the 2026 season, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

headline: Commanders LB Leo Chenal To Undergo Season-Ending Neck Surgery

headline: Giants Fear Brian Burns Suffered ACL Tear

Edge rusher Brian Burns is feared to have suffered an ACL tear, ESPN’s Adam Schefter and NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport report. headline: Report: Vikings TE Josh Oliver believed to have torn biceps
summary: Vikings tight end Josh Oliver left Sunday's win over the Buccaneers with an injury that could keep him off the field for a long time.

headline: Bo Nix and Talanoa Hufanga lead the Broncos past the Rams 30-26 in a Sunday night thriller
summary: - Bo Nix didn't flinch from his slow start and Talanoa Hufanga didn't lose faith after dropping two interceptions Sunday night.
